text: [calm, natural narrator voice] A twenty twenty-six preprint compared ways to impose zero divergence on flat flows: no single strategy dominates. In three dimensions, we found two exactly divergence-free generators, both preprints: periodic-box turbulence, and a current-free field in the Sun's corona. None handles walls, a vacuum outside and iron inside.
